verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's developer portal documents Windows on Snapdragon development with Arm-native Windows toolchains, the AI Engine Direct SDK, and AI Hub for model optimization. The chip ships as a Windows-on-Arm platform, so there is a vendor-backed dev path, but the evidence centers on NPU/AI tooling rather than general CPU development. Missing for 10: evidence of mature compiler support (e.g., MSVC/LLVM/GCC tuning for Oryon), official CPU optimization guides, any sign the OS and tooling ecosystem treats Windows on Arm as tier one, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
